correctness.rationale: Positivity and radial monomial orthogonality fix the normalization. The exact Tricomi U representation follows by an integrable change of variables; DLMF 13.8.11 and the large-argument K-Bessel expansion give the oscillatory n-power, exponential constant and phase. The nonlinear reciprocal moment differs from its linear term by an exponentially smaller correction. Coefficient decay implies Gevrey-2 derivatives, while a near-maximum cosine subsequence excludes every smaller global Gevrey class. The checker passed 45 finite supplementary assertions; these are not infinite proofs.
